1. First, checking the user's contacts
2. Then sending a thank-you email to each contact

I should explain this limitation and ask the user to provide their contacts or use a different method. I can also help draft the thank-you email text.</think>I can help draft a thank-you email, but I don’t have access to your contacts or Gmail account.

> Hi [Name],
